title: Vegan Spinach Tofu Curry
summary: A creamy Indian-style spinach curry with golden tofu standing in for paneer. It is warmly spiced, savoury and satisfying for a weeknight vegan dinner.

ingredients.name: firm tofu, drained and cut into cubes

steps: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and fry for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly golden on several sides. Transfer to a plate.

Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted, then drain and rinse under cold water. Squeeze out excess water and blend or finely chop to a coarse green purée.
Heat the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil in the frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and golden at the edges.
Add the garlic, ginger and chilli and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the cumin, ground coriander, turmeric and paprika and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the canned tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 5–6 minutes, stirring often, until the tomatoes thicken and the oil starts to separate slightly from the masala.
Stir in the spinach purée and coconut milk. Simmer gently for 5 minutes until the curry is thick, green and creamy.
Add the fried tofu and simmer for 3–4 minutes until heated through and coated in the sauce. Stir in the lemon juice, taste, and adjust salt if needed before serving.
